sources.datasetName: Open Transit Data Delhi — GTFS Static Schedule Baseline
sources.knownLimitations: Represents scheduled operations; does not account for tactical trip curtailments or driver absenteeism.

sources.datasetName: Open Transit Data Delhi — GTFS-Realtime Vehicle Positions Feed
sources.licenseOrAccessConditions: Restricted Research Access / API Token Key Required
sources.geographicCoverage: Delhi Arterial Bus Corridors (DTC & Cluster fleet)
transformationHistory: Coordinate bounds clipping to [28.40, 28.88] N, [76.84, 77.40] E
sources.knownLimitations: Subject to GPS multipath drift and dead-reckoning dropouts in urban flyover shadows.

sources.datasetName: Delhi Metro Rail Network Geometry & Interlocking Topology
sources.geographicCoverage: Metropolitan Delhi & NCR (Yellow, Blue, Violet, Magenta, Pink Lines)
transformationHistory: Digitized station centroids and platform transfer link geometries
Indexed connecting lines at 15 major multimodal hubs
sources.knownLimitations: Topology represents track centerlines; does not capture real-time platform crowding or escalator outages.

sources.provider: RITES Ltd. / Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
sources.datasetName: RITES Comprehensive Transport Study — Outer Ring Road & Radial Screenline Counts
sources.licenseOrAccessConditions: Official Transport Planning Document / Academic Fair Use
transformationHistory: Tabular extraction of directional passenger throughput per peak hour
Separation into 4 calibration screenlines and 4 independent holdout screenlines
sources.knownLimitations: Survey conducted in 2021; expansion factors applied to match 2026 baseline travel growth.

sources.datasetName: OpenStreetMap Delhi Metropolitan Pedestrian & Sidewalk Topology
sources.licenseOrAccessConditions: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL v1.0)
sources.geographicCoverage: National Capital Region Pedestrian Footways, FOBs & Crossings
sources.knownLimitations: Crowdsourced geometry often omits temporary vendor encroachment or non-functioning elevators.

sources.datasetName: Continuous Ambient Air Quality Monitoring Station (CAAQMS) Real-Time Data
sources.licenseOrAccessConditions: National Air Quality Index Public Portal / Restricted API Access
sources.geographicCoverage: NCT Delhi (Mandir Marg, RK Puram, Anand Vihar, Punjabi Bagh)
sources.temporalCoverage: Hourly PM2.5, PM10, NO2, CO ambient concentrations
transformationHistory: JSON payload parsing and quality flag audit
sources.knownLimitations: Station density limited to fixed sensor enclosures; micro-canyon street-level concentrations may vary.

sources.provider: Central Electricity Authority (CEA), Ministry of Power
sources.datasetName: CO2 Baseline Database for the Indian Power Sector (User Guide Version 20.0)
sources.temporalCoverage: FY 2024–2025 Weighted Average Grid Carbon Intensity
transformationHistory: Extraction of Northern Regional Grid Operating Margin emission factor (0.716 kg CO2/kWh)
sources.knownLimitations: Represents grid average generation mix; does not account for dedicated solar PPA off-take variations.

sources.provider: India Meteorological Department (IMD), Ministry of Earth Sciences
sources.datasetName: IMD Regional Weather Surface Observations (Safdarjung & Palam Observatories)
sources.licenseOrAccessConditions: Public Weather Bulletin / National Meteorological Data Sharing
sources.geographicCoverage: Safdarjung (South Delhi) & Palam (West Delhi) Synoptic Stations
sources.temporalCoverage: 3-Hourly Synoptic Weather Observations (Temp, Rain, Visibility, Wind)
transformationHistory: Parsed surface rainfall (mm/hr) and visibility degradation (m)
Categorized into operational weather states: CLEAR, HEATWAVE, RAIN_WATERLOGGED, HAZE_POLLUTION
sources.knownLimitations: Point observations at Safdarjung do not capture localized convective waterlogging cells in North Delhi.
